Import, correct and export a photo. Fix a photo and save a new PNG. Your original stays the same.. You can change brightness, contrast and rotation, then save a PNG. There are no layers or color profiles yet.. Edit a real photo, save it, restart, and reopen it. The saved pixels and file hashes must match.

Full non-destructive photo editor. Crop, fix perspective, use curves, layers and masks, heal, clone and keep versions.. Only basic changes and PNG saving work today.. A layered project with masks must reopen after a restart. Full-size export must keep correct color.

Generate concept art and variants. Make new images and refine them. Earlier results are kept.. Local text-to-image and image-to-image work on development branches.. Make an image on this PC, pick a version, edit it, save it, and reopen it.

Repair, restore, inpaint and upscale photos. Fix damaged or small photos with AI. The app shows what AI changed.. You can find models, but no retouch, repair, fill-in or upscale tool has been tested to run.. Repair real sample photos with masks you can edit. Show before and after. Keep the original.

Batch photo adjustments. Apply one tested edit to many photos at once.. There is no safe queue for editing many files yet.. A batch can be cancelled and reports each failed file. The same input gives the same output. Originals are never overwritten.

Play and inspect local footage. Open a clip, play it, jump to a moment, and mark start and end points.. Playback works. Start and end marks are for preview only and cannot be exported.. Common video formats play, seeking is accurate, no AI model is needed, and file errors can be recovered from.

Capture a video frame for photo editing. Send the frame you see to Photo Studio, then save it if you choose.. Frame capture to Photo Studio works on development branches. The captured frame lasts only for this session.. Capture a real frame, edit it in Photo Studio, and save it only when you choose. The video file does not change.

Edit and export video on a timeline. Trim, arrange, layer, color and preview clips, then save a video.. There is no tested multi-clip editor, timeline renderer or video export.. A multi-clip project renders the same way every time, reopens after a restart, and passes quality checks.

Generate video from a prompt. Describe a shot and make it with a tested model on this PC.. You can plan shots. No video model has been tested to run, so nothing is generated.. Check the model, its license and this PC. Then render with a working Cancel, keep the output, and record where it came from.

Animate a still image into video. Use one of your photos as the starting frame for an animation.. You can pick a photo in the shot planner. Making the video is not available yet.. Record which photo was used, animate it with a tested model, and save a clip that links back to the photo.

Transform an existing video. Change a clip's look or motion. The original clip is kept.. You can pick an open clip and plan the change. Nothing is processed.. Transform a real clip with a tested model, check the frames, and recover cleanly from cancel or failure.

Place photos in a video. Add stills, overlays and transitions to a movie.. Media Library opens photos and videos. There is no multi-track timeline to combine them.. Put photos and overlays in a video sequence and save a video file that plays correctly.

Reframe for social formats. Crop a video for tall, square or wide screens.. You can choose a frame shape when planning a shot. Real video cropping and export do not exist.. Crop a real video safely, with moving crop points, and save a clip with the right shape.

Denoise and sharpen footage. Clean up grainy or dark video without losing real detail.. You can choose a clip and plan the fix. Nothing is processed.. Compare before and after, measure the quality, run reliably on this PC, and keep the original.

Upscale video to HD or 4K. Make video larger, with honest notes on how much detail it really gains.. You can plan a target size. No upscaling runs yet.. A tested upscaler with measured detail and flaws, safe graphics-memory use, and a valid saved file.

Stabilize shaky footage. Smooth out camera shake and see how much the frame is cropped.. Planning only. Nothing is processed.. A steadier clip with a crop preview, a before-and-after check, and the same result each time.

Restore old and damaged video. Fix old video, color and scratches without harming the original.. You can plan the repair steps. Nothing is processed.. Check the source first, run a tested repair, compare side by side, and record what changed.

Improve motion smoothness. Add in-between frames where it helps, and show where it adds flaws.. Planning only. Nothing is processed.. A tested frame tool that keeps the clip's timing and reports its quality.

Storyboard a short film. Plan shots, prompts, camera moves, references and lengths.. You can build and reorder a shot list for this session. It is not saved, and it cannot render.. Save the storyboard in a project, link its sources, compare shots, and pick up after a restart.

Keep characters and visuals consistent. Reuse reference images and characters so scenes match.. Each shot can use one reference. There is no saved set of characters or references.. Use several references with clear rules, and keep a version history for everything made from them.

Assemble and finish a short film. Put made and imported scenes together, add titles and color, and save the film.. There is no scene timeline, real transitions, titles or full-movie export.. Go from storyboard to footage to timeline to a finished movie that reopens after a restart.

Private project media and version history. Keep originals, edits, versions and their history safe across restarts.. Projects store basic details. Imports, shot plans and captured frames last only for this session.. Clear rules for where files go, no surprise OneDrive copies, a lasting history, and safe upgrades.

Content intent and adult model consent. Set general, mature or adult intent apart from model search and image reveal.. Shots can carry an intent label, and adult model search has its own opt-in. Neither is an age check or permission to run.. The app itself enforces rights, asks before revealing images, checks age where the law requires it, and stores files safely.

Offline editing without AI models. Import, edit and save without a Hugging Face account.. Basic photo editing and saving work with no models. Full offline video editing is not built.. On a fresh install with no internet, photo and video work can be finished and saved.

Resumable render and download jobs. See lasting progress, cancel safely, and recover after a restart.. Model downloads show progress and can be cancelled on development branches. Video render jobs are not connected.. Each job keeps its exact identity, is picked up again after a restart, never leaves broken files, and handles failures.
